qa_pairs.question: What information is available to users under the 'User Summary' tab in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the 'User Summary' tab, users can find their quotas for various file systems, as well as a list of their 10 most recent tasks.

qa_pairs.question: How can users access detailed information for a specific task or view all their tasks from the 'User Summary' tab?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can select a task from their list of 10 recent tasks by its number to access its detailed page. To view all tasks, they can click on '(Plus de détails),' which will redirect them to the 'Task Statistics' tab.
